text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa gets message from U.S. President Clinton, receives U.S. Defence Secretary Perry who was touring Gulf Arab states to mobilise support against Iraq.
- Crown Prince Sheikh Hamad bin Isa al-Khalifa renews Bahrain's support for Kuwait's security and stability in telephone call with Kuwaiti Crown Prince Sheikh Saad.
- Asian killed when unidentified people torched two stores in a Bahraini village.
- A special force unit from the United Arab Emirates arrives in Bahrain to conduct mobilisation exercises with Bahraini units.
